selection_rule: After the La Libertad outlet is independently FROZEN, use the first frozen margin whose D8 upstream catchment from that outlet does not touch the DEM crop boundary.
outlet_mapping_rule: Map only the frozen accepted outlet coordinate to the containing 30 m grid cell and require cell-center distance <= one DEM-cell diagonal.
source_integrity_rule: Any Copernicus tile shared with the outlet diagnostic must reproduce its persisted SHA256 exactly.
neighboring_outlet_role: Pedregal and Carossio coordinates are extent/context guards only; they may not move, select, optimize, clip, or reshape the La Libertad catchment.
forbidden_inputs: published basin area or channel length as fitting targets
